description: Header file defining the ocudulog::log_channel class, including configuration, thread-safe logging methods, and external dependencies.

classes.name: log_channel
classes.description: Thread-safe class for logging messages to various sinks with configurable context and formatting.

methods.name: set_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the log channel.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Checks if the log channel is enabled.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the log channel.

methods.name: set_context
methods.description: Sets the context value for log entries.

methods.name: set_hex_dump_max_size
methods.description: Sets maximum size for hex dump in log entries.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Various overloads to build and send log entries with different data types and contexts.
